1.title: Carney calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
1.summary: Canada's prime minister said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs as he accused the US of starting a trade war.

2.title: Police Chief in Mississippi Regularly Used Racist Slurs, Private Text Messages Reveal
2.summary: Text exchanges obtained by reporters show troubling messages sent by the chief of a Mississippi police department facing an uproar over the fatal shooting of a 1-year-old boy in June.

3.title: How the Billionaire Joe Lonsdale Shaped Trump’s Homelessness Policy
3.summary: As Republicans have embraced tough measures to clear the streets, no group has led the way more than the Cicero Institute, founded by the venture capitalist Joe Lonsdale.

4.title: Carney Slams U.S.-Canada Trade Proposal and Vows Retaliation
4.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney gave a powerful speech to Canadians on Saturday morning, hours after ordering negotiators to suspend U.S. trade talks despite President Trump’s punishing tariffs.

5.title: Carney calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
5.summary: Canada's prime minister said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs as he accused the US of starting a trade war.

6.title: Canada-U.S. Trade War Escalates as Talks Collapse
6.summary: Intense negotiations to stave off new levies by the Trump administration ended in an impasse as Mark Carney suspended talks. U.S. tariffs on Canada, and retaliatory tariffs on the U.S., will come into effect.
